name: io.orch8/orch8
title: Orch8
description: Author, lint, preflight and run durable Orch8 workflows; inspect instances, signals and DLQ.

orch8_host.description: Host (and optional port) of your self-hosted Orch8 engine, e.g. orch8.example.com

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: Orch8 API key (root key or a tenant key with the operator capability)

headers.name: x-tenant-id
headers.description: Tenant the MCP session operates in (required unless the key is tenant-scoped)
